preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of elements in each array n must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must be a positive integer between 1 and 100,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (0 <= k <= 3*n and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for i, j, x in operations))
postconditions.description: If no suitable sequence of operations exists, output -1; otherwise, output the number of operations k and the operations themselves.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i == a[0] for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: After performing the operations, all elements in the array must be equal.
